proposals.premise: Members often know the job before the tool name, so lead with tasks like “Solder a joint.”
proposals.opening: Desktop shows task buttons beside a tool list. On phones, the buttons sit above it. Each tool’s use and status share a row.
proposals.move: “Solder a joint” brings the two available irons into view with the three-day loan, free required induction, and both pickup windows. Request an iron, then confirm the eligible item and chosen window in the same panel.
proposals.tradeoff: Beginners can start in their own words. Returning borrowers scan past the task buttons.

proposals.premise: Staffed pickup has two windows, so let members start with the one they can make.
proposals.opening: Desktop pairs Tuesday 18–20 and Saturday 10–14 buttons with a tool table. On phones, the buttons sit above stacked entries. Each entry pairs a plain-language use with its status.
proposals.move: Choose a window to show it beside the request button for the two available irons. The camera shows “Due Thursday” and the multimeter “Damaged lead · supervised bench only.” Review the three-day loan and free required induction, then confirm the eligible iron and window.
proposals.tradeoff: Members settle pickup early. Those unsure what to borrow need to scan the tool descriptions.
